sentences.pt: Bruno tinha alugado um apartamento novo em Belo Horizonte, no quinto andar de um prédio antigo.
sentences.en: Bruno had rented a new apartment in Belo Horizonte, on the fifth floor of an old building.

sentences.pt: Para economizar, decidiu fazer a mudança sozinho, com a ajuda do amigo Diego.
sentences.en: To save money, he decided to do the move himself, with the help of his friend Diego.

sentences.pt: No sábado de manhã, eles alugaram um caminhão pequeno e carregaram tudo.
sentences.en: On Saturday morning, they rented a small truck and loaded everything.

sentences.pt: Quando chegaram ao prédio novo, tiveram a primeira surpresa: o elevador estava quebrado.
sentences.en: When they arrived at the new building, they had the first surprise: the elevator was broken.

sentences.pt: — Não acredito! Vamos ter que subir tudo pela escada — disse Diego.
sentences.en: "I don't believe it! We'll have to carry everything up the stairs," said Diego.

sentences.pt: Eles subiram e desceram a escada muitas vezes, carregando malas, mochilas, livros e cadeiras.
sentences.en: They went up and down the stairs many times, carrying suitcases, backpacks, books and chairs.

sentences.pt: Depois de duas horas, os dois estavam cansados e com muita sede.
sentences.en: After two hours, the two of them were tired and very thirsty.

sentences.pt: O grande problema, no entanto, era o sofá.
sentences.en: The big problem, however, was the sofa.

sentences.pt: Era um sofá velho e pesado, que Bruno tinha herdado da avó.
sentences.en: It was an old, heavy sofa that Bruno had inherited from his grandmother.

sentences.pt: Eles levantaram o sofá, empurraram, puxaram e viraram de lado, mas ele não passava pela porta.
sentences.en: They lifted the sofa, pushed, pulled and turned it on its side, but it wouldn't go through the door.

sentences.pt: — Acho que a gente vai ter que deixar o sofá na rua — disse Diego, cansado.
sentences.en: "I think we'll have to leave the sofa in the street," said Diego, tired.

sentences.pt: Bruno não queria desistir, porque gostava muito daquele sofá.
sentences.en: Bruno didn't want to give up, because he really loved that sofa.

sentences.pt: Nesse momento, uma vizinha do terceiro andar abriu a porta para ver o que estava acontecendo.
sentences.en: At that moment, a neighbor from the third floor opened the door to see what was happening.

sentences.pt: Era Dona Lúcia, uma senhora aposentada que tinha trabalhado com mudanças a vida inteira.
sentences.en: It was Dona Lúcia, a retired lady who had worked with moving her whole life.

sentences.pt: Ela olhou o sofá por um instante e começou a rir.
sentences.en: She looked at the sofa for a moment and started to laugh.

sentences.pt: — Meninos, é só tirar os pés do sofá!
sentences.en: "Boys, you just have to take the feet off the sofa!"

sentences.pt: Os dois se olharam, surpresos. Ninguém tinha pensado nisso.
sentences.en: The two looked at each other, surprised. Nobody had thought of that.

sentences.pt: Dona Lúcia trouxe uma chave do apartamento dela e ajudou a tirar os pés.
sentences.en: Dona Lúcia brought a wrench from her apartment and helped take the feet off.

sentences.pt: Desta vez, o sofá passou pela porta sem problema.
sentences.en: This time, the sofa went through the door without a problem.

sentences.pt: Bruno e Diego colocaram o sofá na sala e colocaram os pés de volta.
sentences.en: Bruno and Diego put the sofa in the living room and put the feet back on.

sentences.pt: Para dizer obrigado, Bruno convidou Dona Lúcia para comer pizza com eles.
sentences.en: To say thank you, Bruno invited Dona Lúcia to eat pizza with them.

sentences.pt: À noite, os três sentaram no sofá e conversaram até tarde.
sentences.en: In the evening, the three sat on the sofa and talked until late.

sentences.pt: Bruno pensou que, no fim, tinha encontrado mais do que um apartamento: tinha encontrado uma amiga.
sentences.en: Bruno thought that, in the end, he had found more than an apartment: he had found a friend.

questions.q: Por que eles subiram tudo pela escada?
questions.qEn: Why did they carry everything up the stairs?

questions.q: Qual era o problema com o sofá?
questions.qEn: What was the problem with the sofa?

sentences.pt: Aline ia dirigir de Porto Alegre até Florianópolis para visitar a irmã.
sentences.en: Aline was going to drive from Porto Alegre to Florianópolis to visit her sister.

sentences.pt: Ela tinha tirado a carteira de motorista recentemente e nunca tinha viajado sozinha.
sentences.en: She had recently gotten her driver's license and had never traveled alone.

sentences.pt: Antes de sair, verificou os pneus, abasteceu o carro e colocou a mala no carro.
sentences.en: Before leaving, she checked the tires, filled up the car and put her suitcase in the car.

sentences.pt: A viagem começou bem: o dia estava ensolarado e a rodovia estava vazia.
sentences.en: The trip started well: the day was sunny and the highway was empty.

sentences.pt: Depois de duas horas, porém, Aline ouviu algo estranho e sentiu o carro puxar para a direita.
sentences.en: After two hours, however, Aline heard something strange and felt the car pull to the right.

sentences.pt: Ela foi para a direita com cuidado e parou no acostamento.
sentences.en: She moved to the right carefully and stopped on the shoulder.

sentences.pt: Quando desceu do carro, viu que um pneu estava vazio.
sentences.en: When she got out of the car, she saw that one tire was flat.

sentences.pt: Aline ficou nervosa. Ela sabia como fazer, mas nunca tinha trocado um pneu.
sentences.en: Aline got nervous. She knew how to do it, but she had never changed a tire.

sentences.pt: Primeiro, tentou ligar para a irmã, mas o celular estava sem sinal.
sentences.en: First, she tried to call her sister, but her phone had no signal.

sentences.pt: Então respirou fundo e decidiu tentar sozinha.
sentences.en: So she took a deep breath and decided to try by herself.

sentences.pt: Abriu o porta-malas e tirou o outro pneu.
sentences.en: She opened the trunk and took out the spare tire.

sentences.pt: Ela tentou tirar o pneu vazio, mas tudo estava muito duro.
sentences.en: She tried to take off the flat tire, but everything was very tight.

sentences.pt: Empurrou com as mãos e depois com o pé, mas não conseguiu.
sentences.en: She pushed with her hands and then with her foot, but she couldn't.

sentences.pt: Nesse momento, um caminhão parou atrás do carro dela.
sentences.en: At that moment, a truck stopped behind her car.

sentences.pt: Um motorista de uns cinquenta anos desceu e perguntou se ela precisava de ajuda.
sentences.en: A driver of about fifty got out and asked if she needed help.

sentences.pt: Aline desconfiou um pouco no começo, mas o homem foi muito educado.
sentences.en: Aline was a little suspicious at first, but the man was very polite.

sentences.pt: — Eu não vou trocar o pneu para você. Vou ensinar, e você faz.
sentences.en: "I'm not going to change the tire for you. I'll teach you, and you do it."

sentences.pt: Ele mostrou como usar o peso do corpo para tirar o pneu.
sentences.en: He showed her how to use her body weight to take off the tire.

sentences.pt: Depois explicou como levantar o carro e colocar o pneu novo no lugar.
sentences.en: Then he explained how to lift the car and put the new tire in place.

sentences.pt: Em vinte minutos, Aline tinha trocado o pneu sozinha, com as mãos sujas, mas muito feliz.
sentences.en: In twenty minutes, Aline had changed the tire herself, with dirty hands but very happy.

sentences.pt: Ela quis pagar um café para o motorista, mas ele não aceitou.
sentences.en: She wanted to buy the driver a coffee, but he didn't accept.

sentences.pt: — É só ajudar o próximo que precisar — disse ele, antes de ir embora.
sentences.en: "Just help the next person who needs it," he said, before leaving.

sentences.pt: Aline chegou a Florianópolis no fim da tarde, cansada mas orgulhosa.
sentences.en: Aline arrived in Florianópolis in the late afternoon, tired but proud.

sentences.pt: Quando contou a história, a irmã nem acreditou.
sentences.en: When she told the story, her sister could hardly believe it.

questions.q: Por que Aline não ligou para a irmã?
questions.qEn: Why didn't Aline call her sister?
